title: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'section_title_tag' parameter in all…
description: A WordPress plugin is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'section_title_tag' parameter in all versions up to and including 9.1. The vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher to inject arbitrary scripts that execute when a page is viewed. The plugin's helper function to sanitize this parameter is not invoked in the accordion render path, and standard content sanitization does not cover shortcode attributes, leaving the malicious input stored and executable.
